name: Haydee 2
summary: Unforgiving retro-style Resident Evil / Metroidvania sci-fi facility puzzle shooter famed for huge Steam Workshop custom outfits & maps.
ranking_rationale: Brilliantly intricate interconnected sci-fi labyrinth puzzling and scarce-ammo tension (trade-off: zero handholding—punishing save rooms & maze difficulty overwhelm casual players).

pricing.notes: Pricing and promos change frequently; verify directly at official checkout.
